glimmerling.name: Glimmerling
glimmerling.description: A moth-sprite whose wings cup a cold, living flame.

wickmoth.name: Wickmoth
wickmoth.description: Soot-winged and oil-slick, it coughs cinders when startled.

cobbleback.name: Cobbleback
cobbleback.description: A squat beetle of packed cobbles and rusted nail-heads.

nailbit.name: Nailbit
nailbit.description: A fidget of wire that chews metal and spits bright filings.

briarseed.name: Briarseed
briarseed.description: A walking seed-hull, thorns for a coat and roots for toes.

marrowl.name: Marrowl
marrowl.description: Bone-pale owl that hunts in the hush between heartbeats.

veilcrawler.name: Veilcrawler
veilcrawler.description: A shroud-long crawler that peels darkness off the walls.

brinekit.name: Brinekit
brinekit.description: A slick kit with gill-frills and a pouch of black-water brine.
